title: Good: decode.rs QP false-truncation guard with independent oracle tests
description: mime-tree/src/decode.rs: the QP decode_limited path guards against false truncation where a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence or a soft line break causes the limited output to be shorter than the decoded limit even though more output was available. The guard (compare decoded.len() <= n when input was limited) is correct and backed by tests with Python's quopri module as the oracle. The test coverage of the exact-boundary and off-by-one cases is thorough. This is a real subtlety in QP decoding that most MIME parsers get wrong. Worth defending against any 'simplification' that removes the guard or changes the comparison to strict <.
close_reason: Positive review finding — design decision worth defending. No change needed.
